         ^

Thanks a lot! 

Alex

messages.author: 58d9c38c065185e8
messages.subject: Re: Use source() inside sidebarPanel()
parts:
Hi, I found the error:

The source file common_ui_code.R must be a list(), otherwise fails with given error.

Now works ok:

===========  common_ui_code.R  ===========  

list(
    checkboxInput("opt_enable", strong("enable options"), FALSE),
                   
    HTML('<div class="where_opt">'),

     ...

    HTML('</div>')
)

=========== END  common_ui_code.R  ===========  


Thanks!

messages.subject: Re: Use source() inside sidebarPanel()
parts:
Yes and you don't need to source. Define this list in global.R 

common_ui <- list(...)

and then simply type common_ui in ui.R.
